source_review.notes: Checked all ten final official references on 2026-08-31. The five NASA pages and current GAO-25-106454 HTML returned HTTP 200 directly. The two DAU-hosted PDFs and GAO-21-68/GAO-03-329 official pages were reviewed through their official indexed text, but direct curl requests from this environment returned HTTP 403; the chapter does not claim direct HTTP-200 retrieval for them. DoD SoS characteristics and governance types are presented as diagnostic guidance requiring context, while GAO findings remain bounded case evidence rather than universal causal claims.

evidence: Reviewed time-indexed SoS tuple S_t=(constituents, relations, governance, mission, environment/evidence).
Reviewed conditional constituent set C(q,t,e), typed relation set, mission-thread requirements, and availability/conformance/authorization/evidence predicates.
Reviewed necessary readiness implications without asserting their converse or a sufficiency theorem.
Reviewed operational- and managerial-independence notation as context-sensitive evidence claims rather than intrinsic binary properties.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation preserves mission, coalition, time, environment, authority, and evidence context and distinguishes necessary gates from mission success.

evidence: Executed sos-mission-thread-membership-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-091/report.json.
Confirmed five declared constituents, five declared operationally independent systems, four initial available systems, and identity_service as the sole missing member.
Confirmed restoration produces five available members and only eligibility for a declared metadata gate.
Recomputed Example 9 as 0.91 times 0.96 equals 0.8736 or 87.36 percent before other limits.
Recomputed Exercise 2 as 0.99 times 0.98 times 0.97 times 0.95 times 0.92 times 0.90 equals 0.7405508268 or approximately 74.06 percent under the stated independence assumption.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Boolean membership and simplified independent-event products do not establish semantic interoperability, correlation structure, configuration, human action, resilience, evidence truth, or mission readiness.

evidence: Confirmed large size or geographic distribution does not entail operational and managerial independence.
Confirmed constituent acceptance and local availability do not entail end-to-end thread behavior or stakeholder outcomes.
Confirmed connectivity and syntactic parsing do not entail semantic, temporal, policy, operational, human, or recovery interoperability.
Confirmed declared authority, architecture publication, or a governance label does not entail effective decision rights, funding, enforcement, or incident control.
Confirmed passing one coalition demonstration does not entail readiness for other configurations, scenarios, environments, threats, durations, or outcomes.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The chapter consistently rejects invalid converse reasoning and scopes claims to actual coalition, mission, time, environment, and evidence.

evidence: Challenged two-constituent and thousand-node cases, mixed operational/managerial independence, dedicated enablers, hidden common services, substitute/latent members, and changing emergency authority.

Challenged schema-valid but semantically incompatible identity/time/unit/policy data, standard profiles and extensions, proprietary interfaces, unavailable/stale data, and classification or jurisdiction denial.

Challenged asynchronous releases, absent notice, unsupported versions, gateways, coalition changes, disconnected participants, conflicting local metrics, funding gaps, and authority without enforcement.
Challenged feedback, rebound effects, congestion, common-cause identity/cloud/supplier/policy failure, cascading load, misleading stale observations, malicious participants, and recovery order.
Reviewed ten distinct examples and five answers for concrete reasoning, counterexamples, assumptions, evidence envelopes, uncertainties, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real decisions require constituent owners/operators, domain experts, architects, interface/data authorities, human-factors expertise, safety/security/privacy authorities, V&V, legal/regulatory, finance, and empowered SoS governance.

evidence: Confirmed classification is evidence-based and never inferred from size, distribution, networking, vendors, or organizational importance alone.
Confirmed boundary, mission, scenario, coalition state, time, environment, effectivity, assumptions, and decision authority accompany readiness claims.
Confirmed critical mission-thread interactions have named obligations, owners, multidimensional contracts, evidence, exceptions, monitoring, and recovery.
Confirmed federated baselines distinguish constituent-controlled internals from shared version/effectivity, interface, policy, evidence, and compatibility knowledge.
Confirmed local/global objectives, incentives, veto constraints, common cause, emergence, asynchronous change, representative coalitions, and actual observations precede broad conclusions.
Confirmed material mission, membership, owner, policy, version, dependency, threat, or environment changes trigger reassessment.
invariant_checking.notes: No inventory, architecture diagram, interface standard, local metric, committee, telemetry volume, exercise, or Boolean gate is treated as sufficient alone.

proof_review.notes: No formal theorem or proof is claimed; readiness implications are explicitly bounded necessary-condition models.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is labeled or presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled declared_boolean_dependency_only and eligibility for a declared metadata gate.
The fixture disclaims semantics, timing, trust, policy, capacity, human action, resilience, evidence truth, emergence, and real mission readiness.
GAO findings are identified as bounded official audit cases and are not generalized into a universal law of SoS failure.
Examples and exercises are synthetic teaching cases, not actual architecture, interoperability, governance, safety, security, policy, or operational approvals.
Official sources are attributed without claiming DoD, Air Force, DAU, GAO, or NASA review, approval, or endorsement of the chapter.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Source-backed guidance, public audit evidence, simplified numerical models, synthetic fixtures, internal review, and externally authorized readiness remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked SoS diagnosis, neighboring system forms, operational/managerial independence, dynamic boundaries, governance types, mission threads, multidimensional interoperability, federated configuration, asynchronous evolution, emergence, incentives, resilience, evidence, measurement, monitoring, and bounded readiness.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked constituent roadmaps and authority, interface/data/policy contracts, identity and classification, version/effectivity, gateways and substitutions, change notice, reference environments, coalition tests, incidents, degraded operation, recovery, funding, exceptions, and reassessment triggers.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from diagnosis through boundary, authority, threads, interoperability, evolution, emergence, assurance, and operation. Ten distinct examples and five complete answers cover counterclassification, emergency response, semantics, feedback, incentives, governance, substitution, central dependence, thread arithmetic, demonstration limits, wildfire response, and public health.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external DoD, Air Force, DAU, GAO, NASA, constituent owner/operator, systems/domain engineer, architect, interface/data authority, human-factors specialist, safety/security/privacy authority, V&V authority, legal/regulatory authority, funder, customer, auditor, academic, or other practitioner review is claimed.
